article.title: Turnout doubles as French protesters demand Macron’s government resign
article.author: Editor
article.content: Clashes, arrests, and tear gas in Paris marked a nationwide day of protest backed by students and unions, with 161,500 people rallying across France. The post Turnout doubles as French protesters demand Macron’s government resign appeared first on MR Online .
